svg.title: HamiYami — dinner, cooked nearby, ready for pickup. Live at hamiyami.com
svg.desc: Feature card. The phone shows a real capture of the public HamiYami demo home page, scrolling. The pickup ticket is conceptual artwork. All meals, cooks and availability in the demo are fictional.

g.text: Dinner, cooked nearby, ready for pickup.
A bilingual marketplace demo for neighbourhood cooks in Italy.
A weekly menu by pickup day, reservations with pickup codes
and calendar export, a cook workspace with a day-by-day prep
view, and a scrollytelling story page. Every meal, cook and
number in it is fictional, and the demo says so.
